# Find the K-or of an Array.

@example In binary 5 = 101, 3 = 011 and 6 = 110: bits 0, 1 and 2 each get two votes, so all three win.
[5,3,6]
2
=> 7

@example 12 = 1100, 10 = 1010, 4 = 0100 and 1 = 0001: bits 2 and 3 get two votes, bits 0 and 1 only one.
[12,10,4,1]
2
=> 12

@example The two 8s vote separately, so bit 3 gets two votes; bits 0 and 1 get one each, from the 3.
[8,8,3]
2
=> 8

# A single element (k must be 1): the answer is the element itself.
[0]
1
=> 0

[2147483647]
1
=> 2147483647

# k = 1 is the bitwise OR, bit 30 included.
[1,2,4,1073741824]
1
=> 1073741831

# k = n is the bitwise AND: only bit 30 is in all three.
[2147483647,1073741824,1610612736]
3
=> 1073741824

# k = 3: bit 0 gets 4 votes (more than k) and wins, bit 1 gets exactly 3
# and wins, bit 2 gets 2 (one short) and loses.
[7,7,3,1]
3
=> 3

# Bit 30 wins with exactly k votes.
[1073741824,1073741825,1073741824]
3
=> 1073741824

# Bit 30 is one vote short; bit 0 wins.
[1073741824,1073741825,1,1]
3
=> 1

# Zeros cast no votes.
[0,0,0]
2
=> 0

[0,6,0,6]
2
=> 6

# Every element is nonzero, but no bit gets two votes.
[1,2,4,8]
2
=> 0

# 50 elements: 49 have all 31 bits and one is 0.
[2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,0]
49
=> 2147483647

[2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,2147483647,0]
50
=> 0

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 1 small
[1073741825,4,3,3,1073741825,6,2]
2
=> 1073741831

@gen 5 small
[2147483647,1073741827,2,3,3,1]
2
=> 1073741827

@gen 8 small
[14,4,0,2147483647,2147483647,3,2147483647]
4
=> 15

@gen 9 small
[1,1,1,1073741824,0,1073741824,0]
3
=> 1

@gen 14 small
[0,1,2147483647,1073741837,1073741836]
2
=> 1073741837

@gen 16 small
[10,13,0,7,0,2]
2
=> 15

@gen 22 small
[3,1,1073741824,2,0,1,0]
2
=> 3

@gen 23 small
[6,1,4]
2
=> 4
